title: Server rules
text:
Welcome to Project Arena! Keep it friendly, keep it fun.

**1. Be respectful.** No harassment, bullying, hate speech, slurs or threats, here or in the game.
**2. Keep it clean.** No NSFW, gore or shock content. Players here are 13 and older.
**3. Play fair.** No cheating, exploits or modified game files in online play. Found a bug that gives an edge? Report it, don't use it.
**4. Protect privacy.** Don't share anyone's personal information: real names, addresses, photos or accounts, yours included.
**5. No spam.** No flooding, chain messages or unrelated advertising. Streamers: share your streams and clips in #streaming and #highlights.
**6. Use the right channel.** Bugs in #bug-reports, ideas in #feedback-and-ideas, finding a match in #looking-for-match.
**7. Report problems, don't fight them.** Trouble with a player in the game? Use MENU > REPORT PLAYER (and MUTE). Here, message a moderator.
**8. Follow Discord's rules:** https://discord.com/terms and https://discord.com/guidelines

Moderators may warn, mute or remove anyone who breaks these rules, and serious cases can be banned from the game's servers too. By staying here you agree to them. Have fun out there!

title: The Crowd: cheer from your phone
text:
Follow any online match live on your phone, no app or sign-in needed:
**https://crowd.aftersparc.com**

1. Open the link on your phone (Android or iPhone). Live matches show up by themselves.
2. Tap a match to see the score, the clock, both players' flags and their stats.
3. Tap **CHEER** for a side, as fast as you like. Turn on **SHAKE TO CHEER** to cheer by shaking your phone.
4. **WAVE FLAG** puts your side's flag up in the stands.
5. **CALL IT**: guess who scores next to earn fan points.

The players hear you: the crowd gets louder, their end's lights flash, and hearts and stars burst from the stands.
Tip: add the page to your home screen to open it like an app.

title: How to report a bug
text:
**Best way: report it in the game, right after it happens.**
MENU > **REPORT A BUG** > pick what kind of problem > add a short note > **SEND REPORT**.
It sends your note, your settings and the game's recent log, which shows us what went wrong. Nothing else.

**Or post it here.** Please include:
- what happened, and what you expected
- Quest or PC, and your game version (bottom of the main menu)
- a picture or clip if you have one

**On GitHub:** https://github.com/jendoebelin/ProjectArena-public/issues

Good ideas get credited by name in the release notes.

title: Streaming Project Arena (OBS)
text:
The PC version can draw **only the players and balls, with nothing behind them**, so you can put any background behind them in OBS.

1. Start the spectator: `ProjectArena.exe --spectate --layer 3`, or press **V** in the spectator window until the view is **KEY**.
2. In OBS, add a **Game Capture**: Capture specific window > **Project Arena - Spectator**, and tick **Allow Transparency**.
3. Put a background under it: a picture, a video, or one from the streaming kit.

**Streaming kit** (backgrounds, camera guides and the full guide): the streaming-kit zip on
**https://github.com/jendoebelin/ProjectArena-public/releases**

In the spectator window, **F1** shows all the controls. An Xbox or PlayStation controller works too.

title: Get the game: which version?
text:
**Project Arena is free.** Pick the version for your setup:

🥽 **Meta Quest 2, 3, 3S or Pro** → the Meta Store alpha (below). Easiest, and it updates itself.
🖥️ **PC VR** (Valve Index, Vive, Windows Mixed Reality, or a Quest on Link) → the PC version from GitHub.
👀 **No headset?** → the PC version too: without a headset it opens as a spectator window, so you can watch live matches.
📱 **Just want to cheer?** → The Crowd on your phone: https://crowd.aftersparc.com
🎮 **Steam:** coming soon.

Quest and PC players meet in the same rooms online.

title: Meta Quest: get the alpha
text:
1. On your phone or computer, sign in to the **Meta account your headset uses**.
2. Open **https://www.meta.com/s/4NDP5YlGM** and accept the invite. Access is instant.
3. In the headset, open the **Store** or your **Library**, find **Project Arena** and install it.

**Updates** install by themselves. If the game says **UPDATE AVAILABLE**, open your Library and update it: the alpha needs everyone on the newest version to play online.

**Already sideloading the APK from GitHub?** The store version and the GitHub APK can't be installed over each other. To switch, uninstall the old one first (this starts your statistics fresh).

title: PC VR, or watching on a PC
text:
1. Download the PC zip: **https://github.com/jendoebelin/ProjectArena-public/releases/latest**
2. Unzip it anywhere (keep the **assets** folder next to **ProjectArena.exe**).
3. **To play:** start SteamVR (or Quest Link), put your headset on, then run **ProjectArena.exe**.
4. **To watch:** run **ProjectArena.exe** without a headset. It finds a live match by itself. **F1** shows the controls.

**Updating:** download the new zip and unzip it over the old folder (or into a new one). Your settings and avatar are kept in **%APPDATA%\ProjectArena**.
**Streamers:** see **#streaming** for OBS.

title: Frequently asked questions
text:
**Is it free?** Yes, on Quest and PC.

**How do I get it?** See **#get-the-game**.

**Can Quest and PC players play together?** Yes, in the same online rooms.

**Do I need a headset to watch?** No. The PC version opens as a spectator window without a headset, and The Crowd works on any phone: https://crowd.aftersparc.com

**It says UPDATE AVAILABLE.** Update from your Quest Library (or download the new PC zip). Online play needs everyone on the newest version.

**How do I find a match?** MULTIPLAYER > check **ONLINE: ON** > **HOST A ROOM**, or pick a room to join. Or ask in **#looking-for-match**.

**How do I talk?** Hold the **left grip** in a room (push to talk). SETTINGS > VOICE AND MUTES has open mic and mutes.

**What is HOTDOG MODE?** A match with shields off: the host sets it in MATCH OPTIONS.

**What do you keep about me?** Your player name and your online match statistics (public in the game). Delete them any time: **MY STATS > DELETE MY STATS**. Voice is never recorded. Privacy policy: https://github.com/jendoebelin/ProjectArena-public/blob/main/docs/PRIVACY.md

**Is it on Steam?** Coming soon.

**Something's broken?** Report it in the game (MENU > REPORT A BUG) or in **#bug-reports**. Stuck? Ask in **#help**.

title: How to get help (please read)
text:
Stuck installing, connecting or playing? Ask here. You'll get an answer faster if you include:

1. **Quest or PC** (and which headset)
2. **Your game version** (bottom of the main menu)
3. **What you tried, and what happened** (an error message or a picture helps)

Check **#faq** first: the answer may be there.
Found a bug? **#bug-reports** (or MENU > REPORT A BUG in the game, which sends us the details).
Never share passwords, account details or personal information here.

title: How to play your first match
text:
**Practice:** MAIN MENU > **PLAY PRACTICE** > pick the rules > **START PRACTICE**. You play the bot.

**Online:** MAIN MENU > **MULTIPLAYER**, check it says **ONLINE: ON**, then
- **HOST A ROOM** to open your own arena: pick the rules, set **MATCH OPTIONS**, then **OPEN MY ARENA**, or
- pick an arena in the list to join it.

Waiting outside the tank? Press **JOIN QUEUE** to play next. Two players meet in the middle: **bump fists** to start.

**The rules:** BASIC is a timed match (3 minutes unless the host changes it). ADVANCED is best of three rounds, first to 4 points.
**MATCH OPTIONS** (the host's): shields on or off (**HOTDOG MODE** 🌭), knuckle guards, match time or **FREE PLAY** (no clock, no winner), and round timers for Advanced.

**Talk:** hold the **left grip** (push to talk).
**Re-centre:** press **B** or click a thumbstick.
**More help in the game:** MENU > **HOW TO PLAY**.
